summary: A round exactly as tall as its wall must use the wall up, not be refused (#190). A disc 13 in radius and 2 high has its top circle rounded by 2: the cylindrical wall goes and the body is top, round and bottom. A 40 x 30 x 5 plate has its whole top outline rounded by 5, mitring at the corners. Both volumes are closed form: the removed section, a square of side r less a quarter disc, swept by Pappus round the disc, and along the plate's outline measured at the section's centroid (the mitred corners make that exact). SolidCraft checked 2e-4 relative on a mesh; these check 1e-4 mm^3 (the plate 1e-3: its result is 1.3e-4 off, 2.4e-8 relative, about twice the runner's 1e-8 relative volume integration accuracy on 5300 mm^3). The test's taller-than-the-wall refusals are not ported.
